title: disguise-mod
description: Disguise as mobs, blocks or online players.
body:
# This mod allows you to:

• Disguise as mobs
• Disguise as other players
• Disguise as blocks
• Hidden nametags
• Multiplayer compatible
• Works with NeoForge !

# Commands
Transform to a mob or block:
```
 /transform @s <block/mob name>
```
Transform to player:
```
/transform @s player <player name>
```
Remove Disguises:
```
/reset @s
```

# Transform Stick
Or you can just use the "Transform" stick in the creative inventory and right click on the mob, block or player that you want to transform into.

# Other Notes
This mod currently matches your health to the selected mob, with 10 health for players and blocks, but it doesnt match hitboxes, eyelines, or abilities such as flying or water breathing.
